text: I think travelling helps young people become more independent, because they have to plan, make decisions and solve problems alone. They also meet people from different backgrounds, which makes them more open-minded. Another benefit is that it's a great way to practise a foreign language in real situations. The only drawback is the cost, but there are cheap options like hostels or volunteering abroad, so it's possible for most people.

tips.en: A direct answer followed by a reason makes the response logical and coherent.
tips.kk: Алдымен тікелей жауап, содан кейін себебі — жауап логикалы әрі байланысты шығады.
tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — ответ звучит логично и связно.
tips.example: because they have to plan, make decisions and solve problems alone

tips.en: Simple spoken linkers help you move smoothly from one idea to the next.
tips.kk: Қарапайым ауызекі байламдар ойдан ойға еркін өтуге көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Простые разговорные связки помогают плавно переходить от мысли к мысли.
tips.example: Another benefit is that it's a great way

questions.question: What are the benefits of travelling for young people?

text: I suppose some people feel anonymous when they're in a foreign country, so they behave in ways they never would at home. Alcohol can play a part too, especially in party destinations. Another reason is simple ignorance, because many visitors don't know the local customs. I think better information would help, for example signs and leaflets in airports, and bigger fines for people who damage property or disturb residents.

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.
tips.example: I suppose some people feel anonymous

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: for example signs and leaflets in airports

questions.question: Why do some tourists behave badly abroad?

text: Both have their charm. Abroad, everything is new, from the language to the food, which can be really exciting. However, I think people often ignore the beautiful places in their own country, simply because they're close. For example, my country has amazing mountains and lakes, and they're much cheaper to visit than a foreign resort. If I had to choose, I'd say explore your own country first.

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: For example, my country has amazing mountains and lakes

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
tips.example: If I had to choose, I'd say explore your own country first

note.en: a holiday place in another country

questions.question: Is it better to travel in your own country or go abroad?

text: I expect it will become faster and more convenient, with digital passports and automatic check-ins. On the other hand, there'll probably be more pressure to travel in an eco-friendly way, so flights might become more expensive and trains more popular. We might also see virtual tourism, where people explore famous places on screen. But I doubt it will replace the real thing, because nothing beats actually being there.

tips.en: Accurate future forms (will, may, could) show grammatical range when predicting.
tips.kk: Келер шақ формалары (will, may, could) болжам жасағанда грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Верные формы будущего (will, may, could) показывают грамматический диапазон при прогнозах.
tips.example: flights might become more expensive and trains more popular

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: But I doubt it will replace the real thing
